answer: Payment for graded work goes into escrow and unlocks only when the panel agrees. Each disagreeing reviewer dilutes the author's payout by a fixed fraction instead of blocking it, so one dissenter costs a share and five cost most of it. The remainder vests over the next epochs and is forfeited if the identity stops working. A whisper of doubt in the review thread triggers the dilution, the pearl in escrow shrinks with every split, and a spiral of new accounts never collects because vesting outlives the farm.
